items.name: typecheck-on-edit
items.title: Typecheck On Edit
items.description: A PostToolUse hook that type-checks the project after Claude edits a TypeScript, Python, or Go file and returns the errors as context immediately, listing the edited file's errors first. Uses only the project's own tsc, pyright or mypy, or go vet, and stays silent when none applies. Use to catch type errors in the same step as the edit that caused them instead of at the end of the session.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
